headline: Anthropic's $1.5B copyright settlement is approved, while Google works on a new AI chip for Gemini and OpenAI expresses concerns over open-weight models
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by significant developments in AI regulation, new model releases, and advancements in AI chips. Anthropic's landmark copyright settlement has been approved, and Google is working on a new AI chip to make Gemini more efficient. Meanwhile, OpenAI has expressed concerns over open-weight models, and there are updates on various AI tools and features. The AI landscape is rapidly evolving, with new models, products, and research findings being announced regularly.
